scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Applies to balanced pairs with cutoff N and alphabet size r at least two; no claim about full polycyclic monoids or orthogonal completions. Historic priority against unlocated implicit prefix-monoid enumeration is unresolved. Finite checks support, but do not replace, proofs; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Prefix-depth centralizer spectra and exponential commutativity in finite polycyclic inverse monoids
